item.text: [{"task_id":"b0f4d537","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    divider = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    anchor = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    separators = [c for c in range(grid.shape[1]) if np.all(grid[:, c] == divider)]","    if len(separators) != step or step != 1 or anchor != 0:","        return grid.copy()","    split = separators[anchor]","    left = grid[:, :split]","    right = grid[:, split + step:]","    if np.any(left == marker):","        target = left","        template = right","    else:","        target = right","        template = left","    valid_rows = [r for r in range(template.shape[0]) if np.any(template[r] != divider)]","    if not valid_rows:","        return grid.copy()","    template = template[:valid_rows[-1] + step]","    source_rows = [r for r in range(template.shape[0]) if template[r, anchor] != bg]","    source_cols = [c for c in range(template.shape[1]) if template[anchor, c] != bg]","    target_rows = [r for r in range(target.shape[0]) if target[r, anchor] == marker]","    target_cols = [c for c in range(target.shape[1]) if target[anchor, c] == marker]","    if len(source_rows) != len(target_rows) or len(source_cols) != len(target_cols):","        return grid.copy()","    row_map = dict(zip(target_rows, source_rows))","    col_map = dict(zip(target_cols, source_cols))","    output = np.full(target.shape, bg, dtype=int)","    for r in range(target.shape[0]):","        for c in range(target.shape[1]):","            sr = row_map.get(r, anchor)","            sc = col_map.get(c, anchor)","            output[r, c] = template[sr, sc]","    return output"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,4,5],"geometry":[0,1]},"rationale":"The gray divider separates a small colored line template from a larger yellow scaffold. Match horizontal and vertical lines in order, stretch them across the scaffold, and preserve each template intersection's color. The scaffold's first row and first column identify the destination lines."}]
